title: Greeting, Born Again to a Living Hope, Called to Be Holy

questions.question: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who are elect ____ of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:1 (ESV): "Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who are elect exiles of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,"

questions.question: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the ____, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood:
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:2 (ESV): "according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you."

questions.question: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living ____ through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:3 (ESV): "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,"

questions.question: to an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and ____, kept in heaven for you,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:4 (ESV): "to an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,"

questions.question: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various ____,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:6 (ESV): "In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,"

questions.question: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than ____ that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:7 (ESV): "so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than gold that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Though you have not seen him, you ____ him. Though you do not now see him, you believe in him...
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:8 (ESV): "Though you have not seen him, you love him. Though you do not now see him, you believe in him and rejoice with joy that is inexpressible and filled with glory,"

questions.question: obtaining the outcome of your faith, the ____ of your souls.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:9 (ESV): "obtaining the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls."

questions.question: Concerning this salvation, the ____ who prophesied about the grace that was to be yours searched and inquired carefully,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:10 (ESV): "Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied about the grace that was to be yours searched and inquired carefully,"

questions.question: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you... things into which ____ long to look.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:12 (ESV): "It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you through those who preached the good news to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven, things into which angels long to look."

questions.question: Therefore, preparing your minds for action, and being ____, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:13 (ESV): "Therefore, preparing your minds for action, and being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ."

questions.question: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ____,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:14 (ESV): "As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance,"

questions.question: but as he who called you is holy, you also be ____ in all your conduct, since it is written, "You shall be holy, for I am holy."
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:15-16 (ESV): "but as he who called you is holy, you also be holy in all your conduct, since it is written, 'You shall be holy, for I am holy.'"

questions.question: knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold, but with the precious ____ of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:18-19 (ESV): "knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold, but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot."

questions.question: since you have been born again, not of perishable ____ but of imperishable, through the living and abiding word of God;
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:23 (ESV): "since you have been born again, not of perishable seed but of imperishable, through the living and abiding word of God;"

key_verse_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
